entry.title: Core parking corrupted scheduling baselines; pcore placement is not a large lever
entry.body: Android core_ctl (SM6225 big cluster min_cpus=2) pauses big cores under light load; sched_getaffinity returns requested mask AND active CPUs. scheduling_services captured that transient value as each role's baseline, so render/JQ threads registered during loading got baseline 0-4,7; bo1_mod_pcore 2 then pinned them to CPUs 4,7 only and mode 0 restored the stale mask. Fixed: affinityValue reads Cpus_allowed_list from /proc/self/task/<tid>/status. Fixture native_scheduling_tests_coreparking passes default(90)/pin2(40)/deny-nice(25) on tablet; SDK628 shows render/workers/main/server on 4-7 under mode 2. Same-scene fresh-launch A/B at 720p: off 13.21(warm-up outlier)/15.76, on 15.77/16.19 FPS: placement worth <=~3%, within noise; buggy pre-fix mode 2 measured 14.06 vs 16.33. EAS already keeps bo1-render on A73 at 2.4GHz.

entry.title: ROOT CAUSE FIXED (SDK705): physics fatal ASSERT phys_collision.cpp:1546 Phys_GetUserData(id 0) on gr
entry.body: ROOT CAUSE FIXED (SDK705): physics fatal ASSERT phys_collision.cpp:1546 Phys_GetUserData(id 0) on grenade/mass ragdolls. cdl_proftimer::reset() bubble sort used i<5 with mx[i+1] on a 5-entry array, reading/swapping mx[5] at struct offset 0x60 = gImpulseCacheNum (next .bss object after proftimer_physics_frame_advance, nm 0x5d8ce00). Capture mode is enabled by ragdoll_update.cpp:841/phys_main.cpp:3576, so explosions started the sort, gImpulseCacheNum became a timestamp, and Phys_AddCacheImpulses (nothing ever writes gImpulseCache) processed entry 0 (id 0). Fix: loop i<4 (all platforms). Stack symbolised via inferred load base 0x6f04b19000 (Assert_MyHandler alignment): Phys_GetUserData < Phys_AddCacheImpulses < UpdateRigidBody < Phys_RunToTime < PhysicsSystem_Update. Flame proftimers never start capture. Also measured: NEON skinning 58-74 ns/vertex vs scalar 167-188 ns/vertex (~2.7x).

entry.title: Parallel scene recording implemented (SDK710 candidate, untested on device): r_nativeParallelRecord
entry.body: Parallel scene recording implemented (SDK710 candidate, untested on device): r_nativeParallelRecord 0-3 (default 0) workers. Main lit list (R_DrawLitCallback scope, no prepass, forward-opaque off, no open occlusion query, >=48 surfs) split at material runs into contiguous chunks; worker-safe tess types bsp/smodel_rigid/bmodel/xmodel_rigid go to BO1RecordN threads, unsafe runs + final chunk on render thread (final on real state); each chunk records into its own secondary command buffer inside one pass begun with SECONDARY_COMMAND_BUFFERS, executed in list order. pass_recording: secondary-mode passes for 'parallel host' attachment pairs (main secondaries from lane0), chunk scopes (inherit pass/target/scissor, cannot switch target/open pass), BeginParallel/EndParallel; per-slot ParallelLane x4 (command pool, DrawStorage, packets, arena, frame BindCache) retired at slot fence. Thread-safety: ProgramCache recursive mutex, Texture2D reads/stencil atomics, image_usage BorrowScope (read-only sampling), query begin/end route to current secondary, dynamic index buffer recursive mutex (R_SetIndexData/R_ReserveIndexData/BSP merge; render-thread unsafe chunks hold it), thread_local s_manualObjectPlacement/s_bspRuns/g_bspLitSplits, Com_Error on worker logs+aborts. Chunk states cloned from fork snapshot (engine+native bindings, private source copy with self-pointer rebase, private stats merged after join, worker material_dispatch profiles merged). Log native_parallel_record every 300 calls.
